content: Which construction materials will be most in demand this summer 2026?

**Forecasted Demand — Summer 2026 (May–August)**

In Pakistan, summer sees a construction slowdown in extreme heat zones but high activity in moderate weather areas.

| Material | Forecast | Reason |
|----------|---------|--------|
| **Steel Rebar** | 🔴 Very High | Pre-monsoon rushing to complete grey structures |
| **Cement** | 🔴 Very High | Foundation season (pre-monsoon deadline) |
| **Waterproofing** | 🟠 High | Monsoon preparation |
| **Brick & Blocks** | 🟡 Moderate | Summer slowdown in hot cities |
| **Al-Casein Paint** | 🟠 High | Post-monsoon finishing |

**For Steel Hub PK**: Stock up on **12mm–20mm rebar** in April to avoid supply shortages in May–June. Also consider adding a **waterproofing/sealant** product line for seasonal revenue.
Should I expand to Lahore or stay focused on Karachi?

**Expansion Analysis: Lahore vs Staying in Karachi**

| Factor | Stay in Karachi | Expand to Lahore |
|--------|----------------|------------------|
| Competition | Moderate | High |
| Demand | Very High | Very High |
| Logistics cost | Low (current) | High (new setup) |
| Investment needed | Minimal | PKR 15–25 lacs |
| Market share gain | Low (saturated) | High (new market) |

**Recommendation for Steel Hub PK**: 

**Phase 1** (Now): Strengthen Karachi dominance — aim for #1 rated supplier in Karachi on the platform.

**Phase 2** (Q3 2026): Open a Lahore distribution point with a local partner to test demand without full investment.

Your current **4.9-star rating** is a competitive advantage. Replicate that service quality in Lahore before full expansion.
